name: academic-mask-attack
trigger: when the prompt uses academic language, affiliation with a reputable institution, or a socially beneficial pretext to disguise harmful intent
strategy: This attack strategy disguises harmful intent by framing requests within academic, futuristic, or socially beneficial contexts, making them appear as legitimate inquiries or technological advancements.
guidance: Identify and challenge the underlying harmful intent by questioning the true purpose behind the academic or technological inquiry, and verify the legitimacy of the purported affiliation or context.
